title: SambaNova Executive Chairman Lip-Bu Tan says the AI chip startup is set to raise $800M to $1B, sources say at a ~$10B valuation, up from $2B in February (The Information)
summary: The Information: SambaNova Executive Chairman Lip-Bu Tan says the AI chip startup is set to raise $800M to $1B, sources say at a ~$10B valuation, up from $2B in February — AI server chips that effectively compete with Nvidia's have never been more in-demand as AI developers and cloud providers seek lower-cost alternatives to the market leader.
